up: Retrieve the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), canonical SMILES, and indication details (mesh_heading, efo_term) for all approved drugs indicated for breast cancer. Approved drugs are defined as max_phase = 4 in molecule_dictionary. Filter drug indications where mesh_heading or efo_term contains 'breast cancer'. Join molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures on molregno. Return all matching rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%breast cancer%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%breast cancer%')
